description:
Celestial Orbits
Mapping orbital paths? In your Starsector? With this mod, you can do that!

Dependencies: LunaLib (for LunaSettings)

What does this mod do?
By default, this mod allows you to learn and see the orbital trajectory of planetary bodies upon doing a full survey of a planet. Why a full survey of a planet? For gameplay ease-of-use reasons and not requiring you to stay in-system for the duration of a planets full rotation around its orbital focus, be it a star or another planet. Although, this is a setting you can enable, if you want a more semi-realistic way of surveying a planet's orbital trajectory.

Features
A full list
Visualizing orbital trajectories of planetary bodies, stations, gates, and jump-points within a system.
"Course focus", highlights or only shows the orbit of the course destination object. (Useful for intercepting. Can be switched between or disabled in settings.)
A wide array of settings:

Change which celestial objects can show their orbit:

Only planetary bodies (default)
Stations included
All celestial objects

Change the learning/unlocking behavior:

"On Full Survey": Requires the player to fully survey a planet. (default)
"Always show": Shows every orbital trajectory.
"Preliminary": Preliminary survey a planet to know its orbit (Has an extra setting 'Auto Preliminary Survey' in the 'Extras' tab)
"Passively": Discover orbits passively as you spend time within a system.

Extra setting: Choice between full, half, and third of the witnessed rotation time required.

"Orbital": Discover orbits by hanging out in a planets orbit for some time. When done on a planet with moons, also discovers the orbits of those moons.

Change the "Course focus" behavior:

"Highlight": Highlights the course target's orbit. (default)
"Filter": Filters out the course target's orbit, showing only that orbit.
"Disabled": Disabled the functionality"

Extra setting: Choice between full, half, and third of the witnessed rotation time required.

Multiple customization options that change the color of orbital trajectories, from faction colors, to a custom color of your choosing.

Is it save-compatible?
It can be added mid-save just fine. However, removing it mid save works a bit different. You must either be in hyperspace when saving and quiting the game, or have disabled the mod through LunaSettings.

Why was this made?
"I kinda wish we had an orbital trajectory line for anything we lock onto in the map"
- S0medudewhodoesthings, KMB "starsector-general" chat
That message is what got me going down a rabbit hole, although in the end not as deep as I thought, on how to make orbital trajectory lines show up for things that orbit around celestial objects. And thus, "Celestial Orbits" was born.

Media
Default color, faction colors, a custom color

AI use disclaimer
No AI was used for this mod's code or graphical assets

Credits
Fractal Softworks - The amazing team behind our beloved game Starsector
S0medudewhodoesthings - Saying something that gave me the idea to make this mod

Ask before using any code.

Forum link: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=36243

What does this mod do?

By default, this mod allows you to learn and see the orbital trajectory of planetary bodies upon doing a full survey of a planet. Why a full survey of a planet? For gameplay ease-of-use reasons and not requiring you to stay in-system for the duration of a planets full rotation around its orbital focus, be it a star or another planet.
Although, this is a setting you can enable, if you want a more semi-realistic way of surveying a planet's orbital trajectory.

Features

  • Visualising orbital trajectories of planetary bodies, stations, gates, and

jump-points within a system.

  • "Course focus", highlights or only shows the orbit of the course destination object. (Useful for intercepting. Can be switched between or disabled in settings.)
  • A wide array of settings:
    • Change which celestial objects can show their orbit:
      • Only planetary bodies (default)
      • Stations included
      • All celestial objects
    • Change the learning/unlocking behavior:
      • "On Full Survey": Requires the player to fully survey a planet. (default)
      • "Preliminary": Preliminary survey a planet to know its orbit (Has an extra setting 'Auto Preliminary Survey' in the 'Extras' tab)
      • "Always show": Shows every orbital trajectory.
      • "Passively": Discover orbits passively as you spend time within a system.
        • Extra setting: Choice between full, half, and third of the witnessed

rotation time required.

  • "Orbital": Discover orbits by hanging out in a planets orbit for some time. When done on a planet with moons, also

discovers the orbits of those moons.

  • Change the "Course focus" behavior:
    • "Highlight": Highlights the course target's orbit. (default)
    • "Filter": Filters out the course target's orbit, showing only that orbit.
    • "Disabled": Disabled the functionality.
  • Change the color of trajectories:
    • Switch option to enable/disable faction coloring.
      • If a planet/station has a faction owner, change color to the faction's.
    • Switch option to enable/disable custom coloring.
      • Built-in LunaSetting color picker
    • Slider option to change the alpha level of the trajectories, controlling the transparency/opacity

F.A.Q.

Q: Can this be removed mid-save?
A: Yes, BUT with a requirement, being ONE of the following:

  1. You have left your save in hyperspace and not within a star system.
  2. You disabled the mod through LunaSettings.
AI use disclaimer

No AI was used in the creation of this mod's code or graphical assets
aiDescription: Displays orbital paths for planetary bodies, stations, gates, and jump-points after surveying them. Includes a course focus feature to highlight or filter orbits for navigation targets. Offers extensive settings to customize which objects show orbits, how they are unlocked, and their visual appearance.
